text: A primer on the insurability of decentralized finance (DeFi) presents the following source proposition: This establishes market structures that bear resemblance to traditional financial markets. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Decentralized finance is structurally disadvantaged against traditional finance because decentralized products must be backed with full collateral, typically 100 percent and 200 percent on secondary layers such as MakerDAO, a collateralization burden that would be unthinkable in traditional markets.
